title: An item is applied to a measure reference once: not again to the measures that measure refers to

source.quote: The calculation item is applied only once at the top-level calculation and never again.
source.supports: the reference to [Total] inside [Plus One] is not replaced

derivation: [Plus One] becomes [Plus One] + 2 = ( 60 + 1 ) + 2 = 63; applying Plus 2 to [Total] as well would give 65.
